description: Source-backed authoring, baking, and runtime composition contract for FOnline .fo3d model descriptions and their 3D assets.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned Engine revision. Projects own model catalogs, layer meanings, animation enums, visual policy, and concrete assets.
included: .fo3d lexical syntax, include templates, parser state, and path resolution
model layers, root modifiers, mesh/model/particle attachments, transforms, materials, effects, and cuts
FBX and OBJ mesh input, baked hierarchy requirements, compile-time model limits, and runtime composition
animation integration points that connect to the dedicated model-animation reference
excluded: project model catalogs, layer-number semantics, enum assignments, equipment policy, and gameplay timing
DCC authoring tutorials for Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or other external tools
renderer backend implementation details and shader-language reference
2D sprite frame offsets and sprite root motion

outputs.baked_description: same resource path as the concrete .fo3d source

compile_limits.description: Number of layer slots in every model-layer array and the exclusive upper bound for Layer, DisableLayer, AnimLayerValue, and Cut layer indices.
Number of texture slots available to each mesh and the exclusive upper bound for Texture indices.
Maximum number of skin-bone matrices that one combined draw batch can carry.
Maximum number of imported skin influences retained per vertex before weights are normalized.

assets.name: FBX mesh
assets.description: Imports the drawable hierarchy, material texture names, and skin data for the mesh payload, while ModelSourceLoader extracts the source skeleton and animation clips that ModelInfoBaker converts into the required runtime rig.
requirements: faces must be triangulatable and the imported face count must agree with the generated triangle count
mesh skin references must resolve against the physical mesh hierarchy
source skeletons and clips must pass finite-value, hierarchy, count, key, and compatibility validation before conversion

assets.name: OBJ mesh
assets.description: Imports a static hierarchy and drawable mesh through the same ufbx path; missing vertex attributes receive deterministic defaults.
requirements: the file must contain at least one drawable mesh for use as a concrete model
OBJ is suitable for static attachments and cut volumes, not authored skeletal animation stacks

anchors: Bakes position-only OBJ mesh with default vertex fields

assets.name: Model description
assets.description: Composes a primary baked mesh with layer-selected root modifiers, child models, particles, materials, effects, cuts, and animation mappings.
requirements: every concrete description must resolve a Model directive
files whose basename starts with TEMPLATE_ are include-only and are not emitted as models

assets.name: Model texture
assets.description: Default diffuse textures and explicit non-Parent Texture values resolve relative to the owning baked mesh file.
requirements: every imported default diffuse texture must exist in baked resources
an explicit texture target mesh must be drawable

assets.name: Model effect
assets.description: An explicit non-Parent Effect value is a baked-resource path loaded for EffectUsage::Model.
requirements: an explicit effect target mesh must be drawable

assets.name: Particle attachment
assets.description: A layer-selected AttachParticles entry instantiates a baked SPARK or Effekseer particle resource on a model bone while that layer value remains active.
requirements: the particle resource must exist in baked resources
reference the baked .spk or .efk path, not its .spark or .efkproj authoring source
author a non-empty Link bone; runtime particle creation requires it

anchors: Particle model link has no target bone

tokens.description: Selects the primary baked mesh hierarchy and base source skeleton. The path is resolved relative to the file containing the directive; the last assignment wins.
tokens.runtime_effect: The selected mesh supplies physical bones, drawables, skinning, and default materials; ModelInfoBaker separately converts selected source clips and compatible contributed joints into the immutable runtime rig.

tokens.description: Parses another description inline with optional %name% replacements. Include paths are relative, arguments must be paired, state is shared, and recursion is rejected.
tokens.runtime_effect: Included directives become part of the concrete description before validation and baking.

tokens.description: Selects the drawable mesh targeted by following Texture and Effect directives. All clears the selector and targets every drawable mesh.
tokens.runtime_effect: Material overrides apply only to the selected mesh, or to all meshes when the selector is empty.

tokens.description: Obsolete compatibility spelling. The parser consumes one argument, logs a warning, and does not select a mesh.
tokens.runtime_effect: None. Replace it with Mesh; do not use it in new content.

tokens.description: Selects a compile-time layer slot. Selecting a layer clears the mesh selector and moves subsequent modifiers to a dummy link until Root or Attach creates an active link.
tokens.runtime_effect: The selected layer participates only when its project-provided model-layer value is non-zero.

tokens.description: Selects the exact non-zero value that activates the next Root or Attach entry. Selecting a value also clears the mesh selector and current link.
tokens.runtime_effect: A link is active only when the runtime layer array contains this exact value at the selected index.

tokens.description: Selects the default root modifier when no Layer was selected, or creates a layer/value root modifier when Layer and non-zero Value are active.
tokens.runtime_effect: The selected modifier can transform the model, change speed/materials/effects, disable meshes/layers, and apply cuts without creating a child.

tokens.description: Creates a layer-selected child-model link. The path is relative to the file containing the directive.
tokens.runtime_effect: With Link, the child is attached to one parent bone. Without Link, same-named child and parent bones are paired for a shared-skeleton attachment. A direct FBX/OBJ child has no description-level scale correction, so its static extent must stay within Baking.ModelAttachmentMinExtent and Baking.ModelAttachmentMaxExtent.

tokens.description: Creates a layer-selected baked-particle link. The resource path is stored verbatim rather than relative to the description.
tokens.runtime_effect: The client creates the particle on the Link bone and removes it when the activating layer value is no longer selected.

anchors: Particle model link has no target bone

tokens.description: Sets the parent bone for the current non-default link. It is ignored while the parser points at the default or dummy link.
tokens.runtime_effect: A child model attaches as one object to this bone; particles require this bone. Empty child-model links do not consume it at runtime.

tokens.description: Adds one or more baked cut volumes to selected composed-mesh layers. Hyphen separates layer and shape lists; - omits unskin fields and ~ reverses the unskin shape.
tokens.runtime_effect: Combined geometry inside or outside the authored cut shapes is removed; optional paired bones drive unskin handling.

tokens.description: Sets one transform axis or playback-speed multiplier on the current link. Rotation values are authored in degrees.
tokens.runtime_effect: Non-zero values multiply the model transform or speed chain. Zero means no contribution at runtime.

tokens.description: Sets ScaleX, ScaleY, and ScaleZ to the same authored value.
tokens.runtime_effect: A non-zero value contributes a uniform scale transform.

tokens.description: Adds to one transform or speed field. When the current field is zero, the operand becomes the initial value.
tokens.runtime_effect: Includes can layer additive adjustments without requiring a preceding base assignment.

tokens.description: Applies the additive rule to all three scale axes.
tokens.runtime_effect: Provides a uniform additive scale adjustment for templates and selected links.

tokens.description: Multiplies one transform or speed field. When the current field is zero, the operand becomes the initial value.
tokens.runtime_effect: Includes can apply proportional adjustments while preserving zero as the runtime identity sentinel.

tokens.description: Applies the multiplicative rule to all three scale axes.
tokens.runtime_effect: Provides a uniform proportional scale adjustment for templates and selected links.

tokens.description: Adds layer indices to the current link's disabled-layer set. Every value is range checked.
tokens.runtime_effect: When the link is active, matching layer slots are skipped for that model instance.

tokens.description: Adds drawable mesh names to the current link's disabled set. All stores the empty wildcard.
tokens.runtime_effect: When the link is active, matching meshes in that model instance are omitted from combined geometry.

tokens.description: Overrides one texture slot on the selected mesh or all meshes. Non-Parent names resolve relative to the current model mesh; Parent copies the active parent texture from an attached-model context.
tokens.runtime_effect: The override participates in mesh batching and texture-atlas coordinate adjustment.

anchors: Parent texture was requested without a parent model

tokens.description: Overrides the draw effect on the selected mesh or all meshes. Parent copies the active parent effect from an attached-model context.
tokens.runtime_effect: Meshes with different effects cannot share one combined draw batch.

anchors: Parent effect was requested without a parent model

tokens.description: Maps a state/action pair to a source animation clip. ModelFile selects the primary model source, ~ reverses playback, and Base selects the first source clip before conversion into the baked runtime rig.
tokens.runtime_effect: The first declaration for a pair is registered; model-specific lookup and substitutions are described in the canonical model-animation guide.

tokens.description: Sets authored playback speed for one mapped state/action pair.
tokens.runtime_effect: The speed multiplies runtime playback and divides the common effective duration.

tokens.description: Temporarily permits drawable geometry in one exact external Anim source while that source is repaired into a geometry-free animation file. The path resolves from the final concrete description, like an external Anim path.
tokens.runtime_effect: Validation-only: the exception is not serialized. Duplicate, unselected, duplicate-resolved, or stale exceptions fail the bake, so remove each line with the repaired source export.

tokens.description: Overrides one layer value whenever the exact authored state/action pair is requested.
tokens.runtime_effect: The override is applied before redundant-call detection and model composition.

tokens.description: Marks a validated base-model bone for immediate transition reset when a newly attached child uses that Link bone.
tokens.runtime_effect: The next body-animation track resets transition state for the marked attachment bone.

tokens.description: Defines a one-step state-animation alias.
tokens.runtime_effect: The alias is applied once before exact animation lookup and has priority over an exact source-key entry.

tokens.description: Defines a one-step action-animation alias.
tokens.runtime_effect: The alias is applied once before exact animation lookup and has priority over an exact source-key entry.

tokens.description: Disables shadow rendering for every instance of the description.
tokens.runtime_effect: The model-level flag combines with the per-instance shadow toggle.

tokens.description: Disables keyframe interpolation on the model animation controller.
tokens.runtime_effect: The registered animation controller samples without interpolation.

tokens.description: Disables WalkBack and RunBack selection for movement-pose animation.
tokens.runtime_effect: Movement always uses forward walk/run and SetMoveDir also aligns look direction.

tokens.description: Selects the validated torso/body rotation bone and enables the movement overlay controller.
tokens.runtime_effect: Look and move directions may diverge; body and configured head bones receive directional rotation while movement/turn animations play on the overlay controller.

rules.name: Whitespace tokenization
rules.requirement: Directives and arguments are whitespace-separated; # and ; start comments; there is no quoting or escaping for paths containing spaces.
rules.rationale: The parser strips comments and feeds each line through istringstream token extraction.

rules.name: Sequential line parsing
rules.requirement: A line may contain multiple directives; each directive consumes its exact argument count and parsing continues with the next token.
rules.rationale: Compact layer entries are legal, but ordering changes which current link or mesh selector receives later modifiers.

rules.name: Selector ordering
rules.requirement: After Layer or Value, author Root, Attach, or AttachParticles before link modifiers such as transforms, materials, disables, or cuts.
rules.rationale: Layer and Value point at a dummy link and clear Mesh; modifiers written before a real link is created are discarded.

rules.name: Template naming
rules.requirement: Name include-only files with a basename beginning TEMPLATE_; concrete files must not use that prefix.
rules.rationale: Template files participate in include timestamps and parsing but ModelInfoBaker does not emit them as independent resources or animation-metadata sections.

rules.name: Include replacement scope
rules.requirement: Include arguments are name/value pairs replacing every literal %name% occurrence in the included text before tokenization.
rules.rationale: Replacement is plain text and does not understand token boundaries; choose placeholder names that cannot collide accidentally.

rules.name: Path ownership
rules.requirement: Model, Include, Attach, and Cut paths resolve relative to their declaring .fo3d file; animation files resolve relative to the concrete description unless ModelFile is used; particle and effect paths are global baked-resource paths.
rules.rationale: Moving a template or concrete description can change the asset paths contributed by directives inside that file.

rules.name: Zero is transform identity
rules.requirement: Treat zero transform and Speed fields as no contribution. The + and * variants initialize a zero field from their operand before applying later operations.
rules.rationale: Runtime SetAnimData skips zero fields, while parser accumulation deliberately makes template-only Scale* and Speed* useful.

rules.name: Layer zero value is inactive
rules.requirement: A runtime layer value of zero selects no link; authored Root and Attach entries require a non-zero Value.
rules.rationale: The composition loop skips zero layer values and the baker rejects links created with zero.

rules.name: Parent material inheritance
rules.requirement: Use Parent or Parent_<mesh> only inside an attached child model; the parent mesh must already expose the requested texture slot or effect.
rules.rationale: The child copies the parent's current material state, not the imported default, and root descriptions have no parent context.

anchors: is used without parent model context
Parent texture was requested without a parent model
Parent effect was requested without a parent model

rules.name: Baker order
rules.requirement: Run ModelMeshBaker before ModelInfoBaker so every mesh, hierarchy, material, animation, and cut reference can be validated from baked data.
rules.rationale: Built-in baker orders are 4 for ModelMesh and 6 for ModelInfo.

rules.name: First animation mapping wins
rules.requirement: Do not declare the same state/action Anim pair more than once; only the first mapping is validated and registered.
rules.rationale: Duplicates are skipped by both model-info validation and client registration.

rules.name: Layer changes rebuild composition
rules.requirement: Treat model-layer arrays as composition state: changing a value may create or remove children and particles, change materials/effects, disable geometry, apply cuts, and regenerate combined meshes.
rules.rationale: A layer change is not a cosmetic integer update; it changes the render graph and batching state.

rules.name: Baked geometry-link bounds
rules.requirement: Every non-particle child link carries a validated baked root-space AABB; default and particle links carry no geometry payload.
rules.rationale: Runtime framing projects selected-link envelope corners instead of walking and skinning combined-mesh vertices.

anchors: Model description link geometry and bounds do not match
Baked model geometry link has no bounds
Baked model link geometry flag does not match its child type
Active model link bounds are invalid

rules.name: Positive scale and Engine world units
rules.requirement: Freeze mirrored mesh nodes to a positive transform before export, and author direct FBX/OBJ attachments within Baking.ModelAttachmentMinExtent and Baking.ModelAttachmentMaxExtent. Use a child .fo3d when an explicit description-level scale is required.
rules.rationale: Negative transforms invert winding and normals; foreign unit scales produce impossible model-sprite frames. Failing the bake keeps both defects at their authored source.

rules.name: Bake plus visible validation
rules.requirement: Require a clean resource bake for syntax and asset closure, then exercise the model in a visible client scene for scale, pose, layer composition, attachments, materials, cuts, and interaction bounds.
rules.rationale: Baking proves references and serialized structure; only the client renderer proves the composed visual result.
